segments.name: Testing
segments.description: Provides laboratory developed tests through CLIA-certified labs to help clinicians diagnose and guide cancer treatment decisions.
segments.evidence: In the United States, we offer laboratory developed tests, or LDTs, through our centralized Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988, or CLIA, certified laboratories in South San Francisco and San Diego, California.

segments.name: Product
segments.description: Provides in vitro diagnostic tests distributed to laboratories and hospitals outside the United States that perform the tests locally.
segments.evidence: Outside of the United States, we provide in vitro diagnostic, or IVD, tests to patients through distribution to laboratories and hospitals that can perform the tests locally.

segments.name: Biopharmaceutical and Other
segments.description: Provides biopharmaceutical services, including contract manufacturing and testing, to biopharma customers.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from payers and physicians for its diagnostic tests and from biopharmaceutical customers for services such as contract manufacturing and testing.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our revenue presently comes from sales of our Decipher Prostate and Afirma tests.
